# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository references GitHub Copilot feature preferences that are managed through the GitHub UI:

https://github.com/settings/copilot/features

## Notes

- Repo-specific Copilot toggles are not stored in this codebase.
- Use the GitHub settings page above to enable/disable Copilot features for your account.
- This file is intended to provide guidance for Copilot behavior in this repository.

## Preferred behavior

- Follow the existing project conventions in `app/` and `server/`.
- Keep UI and backend logic separated.
- Prefer clear, idiomatic TypeScript and React code.
- Avoid introducing unrelated changes when editing existing files.
